opening.argument: The title presents Forsage as an online earning system, while the speaker explains participation through upline and downline links. He says joining through another person makes money come from that person, describes activating levels and adding people so amounts return to a wallet, and says further amounts are transferred after another person joins. The displayed account balance and repeated matrix panels reinforce those earnings and tiered participation claims. Referral, wallet, and upline controls further show that the system depends on adding participants and activating levels, rather than on an independent source of returns.
